snippet.title: CLAWPUNK - Release Date Announcement Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Charge into the heart of Feral City and tear through the rioting streets in CLAWPUNK. Choose from nine wild feline warriors, each with their own weapons, stats and special attacks. Smash everything in sight in fully destructible 2D battlegrounds, collect powerful cards to upgrade your cat’s abilities and push the chaos to new heights in this arcade-style, melee-focused action game with roguelite flair.
